from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """A single financial metric extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company this report belongs to")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the financial metric (e.g., '公允价值变动收益')")
    metric_value: float | None = Field(description="The value of the financial metric as reported")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2024年第一季度')")
    document_source: str | None = Field(description="Identifier for the document source")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: list[FinancialReport]
